parameters.name: method_notes.md
parameters.content:
# HCN GIAO shielding plan

Requested system: neutral, singlet HCN in the gas phase, atoms ordered H-C-N.

Method choice: PBE0 (RKS for the closed-shell singlet). PBE0 is an allowed one-parameter hybrid functional (25% HF exchange) and is inexpensive for three atoms while including exact-exchange admixture relevant to shielding. Basis choice: def2-TZVP, an allowed polarized valence triple-zeta basis; the larger flexible basis is preferable to def2-SVP for anisotropic GIAO tensors while remaining modest for HCN under the four-core / 192 MB-per-process limits.

Planned ORCA controls: gas phase (no solvent), charge 0, multiplicity 1, RKS, PBE0/def2-TZVP, GIAO NMR shielding for all nuclei. Resource settings will be recorded in the actual input as required by the native input contract.

Random seed policy: any task-local stochastic algorithm will use seed 1701 and be recorded. If a library/model cannot accept a fixed seed, that will be recorded as not fixable rather than fabricated as deterministic. No random-number method is currently required for the geometry-preparation stage.

goal_giao_shielding_tensor.gap: Requires qualified HCN geometry and a completed GIAO calculation.

goal_isotropic_shielding.gap: Requires completed GIAO tensors for all three nuclei.

goal_trace_consistency_check.gap: Requires completed GIAO tensors and isotropic values.

goal_method_cost_rationale.gap: Method rationale notes are being prepared; actual numerical settings await the ORCA input.

goal_delivery_artifacts.gap: Requires prepared geometry, actual input, raw ORCA output, script, and final tables.

goal_method_geometry_limitations.gap: Requires actual method/geometry results before limitations can be stated.

goal_random_seed_record.gap: Seed policy recorded; final report must confirm whether any stochastic method was used.

proposal.reason: No plan is yet approved and no Steps are ready. The first stage prepares the required identity/geometry anchor and records method/cost/seed policy before any ORCA input is authored. GIAO tensor, isotropic, trace-check, and delivery goals remain gaps until the qualified geometry exists and the actual ORCA calculation can be planned with real artifact hashes.
